Hello LAVAAN members

We're happy to be offering a new on-demand streaming seminar Applied Longitudinal Data Analysis, available now and led by Han Du from Department of Psychology, University of California, Los Angeles. This seminar on Applied Longitudinal Data Analysis explores methods for understanding change and development over time. It covers essential techniques such as multilevel modeling, latent growth curve models, and mediation analysis, with practical applications using R and SPSS. Researchers utilizing the `lavaan` package can apply these skills to implement sophisticated latent growth curve models and longitudinal mediation analyses, thereby enhancing their ability to model dynamic processes in their own research.

Access this seminar at your own pace and feel free to share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
